title: Tether Ships 254M Parameter AI Model for Faster On Device Speech
summary:
The company behind the USDT stablecoin has introduced a new speech to text tool that runs entirely on local hardware to protect user privacy. Known as QVAC TranscribePsy, the 254 million parameter model allows transcription on smartphones and laptops without an internet connection and eliminates the need to send audio data to cloud servers. The issuer of USDT stated that the model outperformed competitors in speed tests conducted across six different smartphones.

The model supports 25 European languages when running on a laptop and 8 languages on mobile devices. In performance tests using an iPhone 17 Pro Max's Neural Engine, the 8 language version transcribed a 10 minute recording in 1.65 seconds. Tether's QVAC division noted that as phones, glasses, and robots shift toward voice interfaces, processing audio locally via the parakeet engine is critical for privacy and functionality.

We just released QVAC TranscribePsy, a speech-to-text model small enough to run inside a phone app.

It covers 25 European languages on a laptop and 8 on a phone, and on an iPhone 17 Pro Max's Neural Engine the 8-language build transcribes a 10-minute recording in 1.65 seconds.

Glasses, robots and phones are moving to voice, and each of them first has to write down what you said. Today that step mostly happens on a server.

TranscribePsy does it on the phone or laptop, so dictation and meeting notes keep working with no signal, and a private conversation can be transcribed without the recording ever leaving the room.

Run it on our qvac-fabric-speech.cpp's parakeet engine, which optimizes for efficient execution and delivers the highest performance.

Get the models: https://t.co/DERAKXa23D
